name: Voice Subtitles
description: Live subtitles for Simple Voice Chat. Shows who is speaking and what they say, taking the roleplay name straight from the player list. Built so that deaf and hard-of-hearing players can follow proximity voice chat, and so that anyone playing without sound can too. Recognition is offline and client-side: no audio ever leaves your machine and nothing is uploaded anywhere. On first use the mod downloads a Vosk speech model (about 45 MB) from alphacephei.com; this can be turned off, and models can be installed by hand instead. A larger, markedly more accurate model is available for those who want it — it costs 1.8 GB of disk and about as much memory. Thanks to Contik for testing.
